AboutUs.title: About us
AboutUs.body: Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is a higher educational institution under the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan, where Islamic values and Sharia principles are taught on an academic basis. Rector.title: Rector
Rector.name: Abdushukur Narmatov
Rector.message: In the Quran, Almighty Allah says: “Allah will raise in درجات those among you who believe and those who have been given knowledge...”. Our Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The scholars are the heirs of the prophets.” The high rank of scholars is tied to their role in uniting the Muslim community, keeping it from straying from the right path, and guiding it toward the path to Paradise. The primary duty of scholars is to preserve harmony among people and strengthen their unity. Throughout human history, no matter how many prophets came, their mission was always to unite people. May Almighty Allah make us steadfast in His religion and among those who guide others to the right path.
Rector.imageAlt: Abdushukur Narmatov, rector of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University

HistoryPage.title: History of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University
HistoryPage.lead: Kyrgyzstan Islamic University is a higher educational institution under the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan, where Islamic values and Sharia principles are taught on an academic basis.
HistoryPage.imageAlt: Image related to the history of Kyrgyzstan Islamic University

paragraphs.foundation: In the early 1990s, the head of Kyrgyzstan's religious administration, Kimsanbay Azhy Abdrakhmanov, proposed opening an Islamic madrasa in Bishkek. This step reflected the need to build a structured and sustainable foundation for religious education in the country.
paragraphs.development: Later, that initiative expanded and became the basis for an educational institution where religious knowledge is combined with academic discipline. The university seeks to approach Islamic sciences together with moral formation, responsibility, and modern educational standards.
paragraphs.today: Today, Kyrgyzstan Islamic University continues to grow as a space that brings together education, research, and spiritual formation, aiming to create a learning environment grounded in values and respect for knowledge.
